records.jp: ねえ、みんな。この世界にいられるのもあと少しだし<CR>手分けして、校内のお掃除でもしない？
records.en_original: Hey, everyone? We don't have much time left here, so how about we split up and clean the school?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, everyone? We don't have much time left here, so how about we split up and clean the school?
records.en: Hey, everyone. We don't have much time left in this world,<CR>so why don't we split up and clean the school?

records.jp: あっ、それはいいですね！<CR>立つ鳥、跡を濁さずと言いますし
records.en_original: What a great idea! It is common courtesy to clean up after yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: What a great idea! It is common courtesy to clean up after yourself.
records.en: Oh, that's a good idea!<CR>They do say, 'A departing bird leaves no mess behind.'

records.jp: えぇー！？<CR>あたし、お掃除って苦手ぇ……
records.en_original: Whaaat?! I hate cleaning!
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaat?! I hate cleaning!
records.en: Whaaat?!<CR>I hate cleaning!

records.jp: まあまあ、そう言わずに！<CR>一番頑張った人には、豪華な賞品もあるから！
records.en_original: Oh, come on now. I've got a fabulous prize for the person who works the hardest!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, come on now. I've got a fabulous prize for the person who works the hardest!
records.en: Oh, come on now.<CR>I've got a fabulous prize for the person who works the hardest!

records.jp: へぇ……賞品なんて用意したんだ。<CR>なに？
records.en_original: Ooh, you've got a reward for us, huh? What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, you've got a reward for us, huh? What is it?
records.en: Ooh, you've got a reward for us, huh?<CR>What is it?

records.jp: リーダーである私が、直々に与える……<CR>「お掃除頑張ったで賞」！！
records.en_original: You will receive a special, one-of-a-kind Best Cleaner Award from yours truly!!
records.en_auxiliary: You will receive a special, one-of-a-kind Best Cleaner Award from yours truly!!
records.en: As leader, I'll personally bestow...<CR>the 'Worked Hard at Cleaning Award'!!

records.jp: えーと……ダメ、かな？
records.en_original: N-not good enough?
records.en_auxiliary: N-not good enough?
records.en: Um... Not good enough?

records.jp: ぷっ……あはは！　そんなことないよ！<CR>私は欲しいな、その賞品！
records.en_original: Pfff! Ahaha! No, I'd love to get a prize like that!
records.en_auxiliary: Pfff! Ahaha! No, I'd love to get a prize like that!
records.en: Pfff! Ahaha! No, I'd love to get<CR>a prize like that!

records.jp: んじゃ、みんなでお掃除大会開催だー！
records.en_original: All right, then! Let the Great Cleaning Competition begin!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, then! Let the Great Cleaning Competition begin!
records.en: Then let the Great Cleaning Competition begin!

records.jp: おー！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: それでは……！　今から、みんなの報告を聞いて<CR>優勝者を決めたいと思います！
records.en_original: So! I will now assess what everybody did and declare the winner!
records.en_auxiliary: So! I will now assess what everybody did and declare the winner!
records.en: Now then...! I'll hear everyone's reports<CR>and decide the winner!

records.jp: わたしは教室のお掃除頑張ったよ。<CR>お世話になった机を、ピカピカにしたの
records.en_original: I cleaned the classrooms. The desks that have served us all so well look like they're new again!
records.en_auxiliary: I cleaned the classrooms. The desks that have served us all so well look like they're new again!
records.en: I cleaned the classroom.<CR>I polished the desks that served us so well until they shone.

records.jp: あたし、体育館！<CR>ちゃんと真面目に掃除したからねー！
records.en_original: I did the gym! I made sure to get all the nooks and crannies!
records.en_auxiliary: I did the gym! I made sure to get all the nooks and crannies!
records.en: I did the gym!<CR>And I really did clean it properly, okay!

records.jp: 私は勇希と体育館を。<CR>大した手間じゃなかったけどね
records.en_original: I was with Yuki in the gym. There wasn't much to be cleaned, to be honest.
records.en_auxiliary: I was with Yuki in the gym. There wasn't much to be cleaned, to be honest.
records.en: I cleaned the gym with Yuki.<CR>It wasn't much trouble, though.

records.jp: 私は保健室を片付けてきたよ。<CR>もうお世話になりませんようにって願いもこめて、ね
records.en_original: I cleaned up the nurse's office. I really hope we don't have to use it again.
records.en_auxiliary: I cleaned up the nurse's office. I really hope we don't have to use it again.
records.en: I tidied the nurse's office.<CR>I even wished we'd never have to use it again.

records.jp: わたしは図書室をお掃除しました。<CR>本が多くて大変でしたけど、楽しかったです
records.en_original: I tidied up the library. There were a lot of books to take care of, but it was fun.
records.en_auxiliary: I tidied up the library. There were a lot of books to take care of, but it was fun.
records.en: I cleaned the library.<CR>There were so many books that it was hard work, but it was fun.

records.jp: きららは屋上……。<CR>風が気持ち良かったのだ
records.en_original: I handled the roof. The breeze felt nice.
records.en_auxiliary: I handled the roof. The breeze felt nice.
records.en: Kirara handled the rooftop...<CR>The breeze felt nice.

records.jp: はーい！　わたしは、作業室！<CR>お鍋も食器も、綺麗にしてきたよ！
records.en_original: Me next! I did the work room! I made sure all the plates and pots were sparkly clean!
records.en_auxiliary: Me next! I did the work room! I made sure all the plates and pots were sparkly clean!
records.en: Me! I did the work room!<CR>I cleaned all the pots and dishes!

records.jp: 廊下の掃除なら、ほぼ完璧なはずよ。<CR>皆がたくさん使った分、かなり汚れていたけれど
records.en_original: The hallways should be perfect now. They were considerably dirty due to our daily use.
records.en_auxiliary: The hallways should be perfect now. They were considerably dirty due to our daily use.
records.en: The hallway should be almost perfect.<CR>It was rather dirty from how much everyone used it, though.

records.jp: 私は、花壇とその周りを。<CR>水やりができるのも、あともう少しなんですね
records.en_original: I straightened up the garden and the area around it. I'll only be able to take care of them for a little while longer...
records.en_auxiliary: I straightened up the garden and the area around it. I'll only be able to take care of them for a little while longer...
records.en: I did the flower bed and the area around it.<CR>I only have a little longer to keep watering it...

records.jp: （うーん、この中で一番頑張った人は……）
records.en_original: (Hmm, sounds like the person that put in the most effort was...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hmm, sounds like the person that put in the most effort was...)
records.en: (Hmm, the person who worked hardest among them was...)

records.jp: こころかな！
records.en_original: Kokoro wins!
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro wins!
records.en: Kokoro, I think!

records.jp: 掃除してるところ見たけど<CR>机の脚まで綺麗にしてたでしょ？
records.en_original: I saw that you even cleaned the legs of the seats and desks.
records.en_auxiliary: I saw that you even cleaned the legs of the seats and desks.
records.en: I saw you cleaning,<CR>and you even cleaned the legs of the desks, right?

records.jp: 私だったら、そこまで出来ないな～と思って
records.en_original: That's not something I would have thought to do.
records.en_auxiliary: That's not something I would have thought to do.
records.en: I never would've thought to go that far.

records.jp: 道具って、ちゃんとお手入れしないと<CR>すぐにダメになっちゃうの
records.en_original: The things we use break down quickly if we don't tend to them regularly.
records.en_auxiliary: The things we use break down quickly if we don't tend to them regularly.
records.en: If you don't take proper care of the things you use,<CR>they quickly become unusable.

records.jp: ありがとうの気持ちも込めて、大事に大事に<CR>してあげると、長持ちしてくれるんだよ
records.en_original: They last so much longer if we take care of them with a sense of appreciation.
records.en_auxiliary: They last so much longer if we take care of them with a sense of appreciation.
records.en: If you take good care of things and appreciate them,<CR>they'll last much longer.

records.jp: 長持ち……。<CR>でも、雫世界がなくなったら……
records.en_original: Last longer... But once Oasis disappears…
records.en_auxiliary: Last longer... But once Oasis disappears…
records.en: Last a long time...<CR>But when Oasis disappears...

records.jp: うん、分かってる。<CR>でも、わたしたちの気持ちはなくならないから
records.en_original: I know. But our feelings will stay.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. But our feelings will stay.
records.en: Yeah, I know.<CR>But our feelings won't disappear.

records.jp: だから愛央ちゃんも<CR>お掃除しようって言ったんでしょ？
records.en_original: Isn't that why you suggested we clean this place?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that why you suggested we clean this place?
records.en: That's why you suggested we clean the school too,<CR>right, Ao-chan?

records.jp: この世界に、ありがとーって言いたくて
records.en_original: As a great, big thank you to this world.
records.en_auxiliary: As a great, big thank you to this world.
records.en: Because you wanted to say thank you to this world.

records.jp: ……っ！　優勝！　文句なしで優勝だよ！
records.en_original: This. This is exactly why you're the winner!
records.en_auxiliary: This. This is exactly why you're the winner!
records.en: ...! You win! You win without question!

records.jp: では、名誉ある「お掃除頑張ったで賞」を授けます
records.en_original: I hereby pronounce you Best Cleaner!
records.en_auxiliary: I hereby pronounce you Best Cleaner!
records.en: Then I present you with the honorable "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award."

records.jp: ふふっ、光栄です！<CR>ありがとうございます、リーダー！
records.en_original: Hehe, thank you, leader! I'm honored!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, thank you, leader! I'm honored!
records.en: Hehe, I'm honored!<CR>Thank you, Leader!

records.jp: 体育館でさ。勇希は素直じゃないから、伶那さんに<CR>お尻叩かれながら掃除してたけど……
records.en_original: So, I saw that Yuki had to be spurred on by Rena to keep cleaning the gym, but...
records.en_auxiliary: So, I saw that Yuki had to be spurred on by Rena to keep cleaning the gym, but...
records.en: At the gym, Rena-san had to keep pushing Yuki<CR>because Yuki wasn't being honest about it, but...

records.jp: なんだかんだ、すっごく大事そうな顔して<CR>掃除してたんだよね。感動しちゃったよ
records.en_original: I also saw how seriously you took it when you were cleaning. I was really moved.
records.en_auxiliary: I also saw how seriously you took it when you were cleaning. I was really moved.
records.en: in the end, she cleaned with a look on her face<CR>like the place really meant a lot to her. It moved me.

records.jp: そ、そりゃ……体育館ではいっぱい遊んだし。<CR>愛着だって湧くってもんだよね……
records.en_original: W-well, we all had so much fun in the gym. It's hard not to get attached, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, we all had so much fun in the gym. It's hard not to get attached, you know?
records.en: W-well, we all had so much fun in the gym.<CR>It's hard not to get attached, you know?

records.jp: えへへ……てことで。名誉ある「お掃除頑張ったで賞」<CR>は、金城 勇希に授けます！
records.en_original: Hehehe... So, the Best Cleaner Award goes to Yuki Kinjou!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe... So, the Best Cleaner Award goes to Yuki Kinjou!
records.en: Ehehe... And so, the honorable "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award"<CR>goes to Kinjou Yuki!

records.jp: うわぁぁぁぁん！　愛央のバカーーーー！<CR>こんなの、感動するに決まってるしーーー！！
records.en_original: Waaaaaaaaaahh! Come on, Ao! How am I not supposed to get emotional after that?!
records.en_auxiliary: Waaaaaaaaaahh! Come on, Ao! How am I not supposed to get emotional after that?!
records.en: Waaaaah! You idiot, Ao!<CR>Of course this was going to make me cry!!

records.jp: 伶那さんかな！<CR>ふっふっふ……実は私、知ってるんだよね
records.en_original: Heh heh heh... Based on what I know, Rena deserves the win.
records.en_auxiliary: Heh heh heh... Based on what I know, Rena deserves the win.
records.en: Heh heh heh...<CR>Based on what I know, Rena-san deserves the win.

records.jp: え、何？　怖いんだけど
records.en_original: Wh-what you know? You're scaring me here...
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what you know? You're scaring me here...
records.en: Huh? What? You're kind of scaring me.

records.jp: 伶那さん、体育館の掃除は<CR>大した手間じゃなかったって言ってたけど……
records.en_original: You said there wasn't much to be cleaned in the gym, but...
records.en_auxiliary: You said there wasn't much to be cleaned in the gym, but...
records.en: Rena-san, you said cleaning<CR>the gym wasn't much work, but...

records.jp: それは伶那さんが、体育館を使うたびに<CR>きっちり掃除してたから！　だよね？
records.en_original: The reason for that is because you cleaned up after we used it every time! Isn't that right?
records.en_auxiliary: The reason for that is because you cleaned up after we used it every time! Isn't that right?
records.en: That's because Rena-san thoroughly cleaned the gym<CR>every single time she used it! Right?

records.jp: そういえば、フロアのモップかけも道具の拭き掃除も<CR>いつもすっごく丁寧にやってたよね！
records.en_original: Come to think of it, she was always mopping the floors and wiping down the equipment we used!
records.en_auxiliary: Come to think of it, she was always mopping the floors and wiping down the equipment we used!
records.en: Come to think of it, she always mopped the floor<CR>and wiped down the equipment so carefully!

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっと！　うるさいんだけど！？
records.en_original: C-cut it out! It was no big deal!
records.en_auxiliary: C-cut it out! It was no big deal!
records.en: H-hey! Be quiet!

records.jp: あははっ！　オーディエンスからもＯＫ出たところで、<CR>「お掃除頑張ったで賞」は、宮内 伶那に授けます！
records.en_original: Ahaha! Since even the audience agrees, the Best Cleaner Award goes to Rena Miyauchi!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! Since even the audience agrees, the Best Cleaner Award goes to Rena Miyauchi!
records.en: Ahaha! Now that the audience approves too,<CR>the "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award" goes to Miyauchi Rena!

records.jp: はあ……言い出したら聞かないんだから。<CR>一応もらっとく
records.en_original: Ugh... I guess there's no use trying to change your mind. Fine, I'll take it.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... I guess there's no use trying to change your mind. Fine, I'll take it.
records.en: Haaah... Once you start, you never listen.<CR>I'll accept it, at least.

records.jp: ……ありがと、ね
records.en_original: ...Thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thanks.
records.en: ...Thanks.

records.jp: 日菜子さん！　理由は……お掃除してるときの目に、<CR>感謝の気持ちがこもってたから！
records.en_original: Hinako! You win! I saw a genuine appreciation in your eyes as you were cleaning!
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako! You win! I saw a genuine appreciation in your eyes as you were cleaning!
records.en: Hinako-san! The reason is... your eyes were filled<CR>with gratitude while you were cleaning!

records.jp: ……感謝、かあ。<CR>確かに、そういう気持ちもあるかも
records.en_original: Appreciation? Yeah, I guess there was a bit of that.
records.en_auxiliary: Appreciation? Yeah, I guess there was a bit of that.
records.en: ...Gratitude, huh.<CR>Yeah, maybe that was part of it.

records.jp: この世界の保健室って、寂しい場所じゃないんだよね。<CR>みんな、怪我人を孤独にさせてくれないんだもん
records.en_original: In this world, the nurse's office isn't a lonely place. Nobody here ever let someone who got hurt have some peace and quiet.
records.en_auxiliary: In this world, the nurse's office isn't a lonely place. Nobody here ever let someone who got hurt have some peace and quiet.
records.en: The nurse's office in this world was never a lonely place.<CR>Everyone refused to leave an injured person alone.

records.jp: でも、そういうところに<CR>私はちょっぴり救われたりもして……
records.en_original: But that kind of nosiness...may have actually helped me once or twice.
records.en_auxiliary: But that kind of nosiness...may have actually helped me once or twice.
records.en: And that part of it<CR>saved me a little too...

records.jp: だから感謝っていうか、<CR>ちょっと恩を感じてたりする場所でもあるのかも
records.en_original: So I think I did project the appreciation I feel for you all onto that place.
records.en_auxiliary: So I think I did project the appreciation I feel for you all onto that place.
records.en: So maybe it's less gratitude<CR>and more that I feel like I owe this place something.

records.jp: そっかあ……えへへ！　その言葉を聞いて、<CR>ますます日菜子さんに賞をあげたくなっちゃった！
records.en_original: I see. Hehe! Hearing that makes me even more sure that you deserve this award!
records.en_auxiliary: I see. Hehe! Hearing that makes me even more sure that you deserve this award!
records.en: I see... Hehe! Hearing that makes me<CR>want to give you the award even more, Hinako-san!

records.jp: 「お掃除頑張ったで賞」を、誰より優しい<CR>白井　日菜子に授けます！
records.en_original: The Best Cleaner Award goes to Hinako Shirai, the kindest of us all!
records.en_auxiliary: The Best Cleaner Award goes to Hinako Shirai, the kindest of us all!
records.en: The "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award" goes to<CR>the kindest of us all, Shirai Hinako!

records.jp: ……ありがと、愛央。<CR>ありがたくもらっておくね
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao. I'll cherish this forever.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Ao. I'll cherish this forever.
records.en: ...Thanks, Ao.<CR>I'll gratefully accept it.

records.jp: 詩帆さんだと思う！
records.en_original: I think Shiho deserves the prize!
records.en_auxiliary: I think Shiho deserves the prize!
records.en: I think Shiho-san!

records.jp: わ、わたしですか？
records.en_original: M-me?
records.en_auxiliary: M-me?
records.en: M-me?

records.jp: うん！　だってだって、<CR>図書室の掃除ってめっちゃ大変そうなのに……
records.en_original: Yeah! The library had to be such a pain to clean!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! The library had to be such a pain to clean!
records.en: Yeah! Cleaning the library<CR>looked incredibly difficult, and yet...

records.jp: 詩帆さん、みんながよく手に取る本を覚えてて、<CR>ちゃんと丁寧にホコリを取ってたよね？
records.en_original: You remembered which books we used the most, and made sure to wipe them down carefully.
records.en_auxiliary: You remembered which books we used the most, and made sure to wipe them down carefully.
records.en: Shiho-san, you remembered the books everyone often picks up<CR>and carefully dusted them, right?

records.jp: 改めて言われると、ちょっと恥ずかしいですね……<CR>でも図書室のお掃除は、ちっとも苦じゃなかったんです
records.en_original: Hearing you say it like that is a bit embarrassing... But it really wasn't much trouble at all.
records.en_auxiliary: Hearing you say it like that is a bit embarrassing... But it really wasn't much trouble at all.
records.en: It's a little embarrassing to hear you say that...<CR>But cleaning the library really wasn't hard at all.

records.jp: 皆さんとの思い出を振り返りながら、<CR>お世話になった場所を綺麗にしていただけなんですから
records.en_original: It felt more like I was reminiscing about the memories we shared in the library than cleaning it.
records.en_auxiliary: It felt more like I was reminiscing about the memories we shared in the library than cleaning it.
records.en: I was simply cleaning a place that had taken care of us<CR>while looking back on my memories with everyone.

records.jp: なんだか、図書室に行くたび<CR>今の詩帆さんの言葉を思い出しそう
records.en_original: I feel like I'm going to think of your words whenever I go to the library now.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like I'm going to think of your words whenever I go to the library now.
records.en: I feel like every time I go to the library,<CR>I will remember what you just said, Shiho-san.

records.jp: ……ありがとう、詩帆さん。<CR>私たちとの思い出を、大切にしてくれて
records.en_original: Thank you, Shiho, for cherishing our memories.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Shiho, for cherishing our memories.
records.en: ...Thank you, Shiho-san.<CR>For cherishing your memories with us.

records.jp: やっぱり、「お掃除頑張ったで賞」は、<CR>春日 詩帆に授けます！　詩帆さん、受け取って！
records.en_original: The Best Cleaner Award is yours, Shiho Kasuga! Please accept it!
records.en_auxiliary: The Best Cleaner Award is yours, Shiho Kasuga! Please accept it!
records.en: After all, the "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award" goes to<CR>Kasuga Shiho! Shiho-san, please accept it!

records.jp: はい……！<CR>ふふ、また素敵な思い出が増えました
records.en_original: It would be my honor! Hehe, another wonderful memory made.
records.en_auxiliary: It would be my honor! Hehe, another wonderful memory made.
records.en: Yes...!<CR>Hehe, I have gained another lovely memory.

records.jp: きららかな！
records.en_original: I think Kirara takes this one!
records.en_auxiliary: I think Kirara takes this one!
records.en: Kirara, I think!

records.jp: 私、きららが屋上にいるところ見たんだけど……<CR>葉っぱ拾ったり、雑草とったり、頑張ってたから
records.en_original: I saw you working hard up on the rooftop, gathering leaves and pulling weeds.
records.en_auxiliary: I saw you working hard up on the rooftop, gathering leaves and pulling weeds.
records.en: I saw Kirara on the rooftop...<CR>She worked hard picking up leaves and pulling weeds.

records.jp: ……みんなが頑張るなら<CR>きららも頑張ろうと思ったのだ
records.en_original: I just thought I should make an effort since everybody else was.
records.en_auxiliary: I just thought I should make an effort since everybody else was.
records.en: ...If everyone else was working hard,<CR>Kirara thought she should work hard too.

records.jp: もしかしたら、みんなと何か一緒に出来るのは<CR>これが最後かもしれないから……
records.en_original: This could very well be the last time I get to do something with all of you.
records.en_auxiliary: This could very well be the last time I get to do something with all of you.
records.en: Because this might be the last time<CR>Kirara can do something together with everyone...

records.jp: きららは、きららとして……<CR>みんなの役に立ちたかったのだ
records.en_original: I wanted to do what I could to be useful.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanted to do what I could to be useful.
records.en: Kirara wanted to be useful to everyone...<CR>as Kirara.

records.jp: ……うん！　やっぱり、優勝はきらら！
records.en_original: I knew it. You deserve this reward the most, Kirara!
records.en_auxiliary: I knew it. You deserve this reward the most, Kirara!
records.en: ...Yeah! Kirara is the winner after all!

records.jp: でも、きららより、みんなのほうが頑張ったと思う
records.en_original: But I think the others did so much more than I did.
records.en_auxiliary: But I think the others did so much more than I did.
records.en: But Kirara thinks everyone else worked harder than Kirara.

records.jp: あのさ、頑張りって自分で評価できないんだよ。<CR>人に評価されてこその頑張りなの
records.en_original: You can't judge the value of your own hard work—especially not the value that work has to others.
records.en_auxiliary: You can't judge the value of your own hard work—especially not the value that work has to others.
records.en: You can't judge your own hard work.<CR>It only really counts when someone else recognizes it.

records.jp: 私は、きららが一番頑張ったと思うから<CR>きららを優勝にするよ
records.en_original: I felt that you worked the hardest, so I decided to choose you as the winner.
records.en_auxiliary: I felt that you worked the hardest, so I decided to choose you as the winner.
records.en: I think Kirara worked the hardest,<CR>so I am making Kirara the winner.

records.jp: ……それでは、きららには<CR>名誉ある「お掃除頑張ったで賞」を授けます！
records.en_original: So, it is my pleasure to present to you, the Best Cleaner Award!
records.en_auxiliary: So, it is my pleasure to present to you, the Best Cleaner Award!
records.en: ...Then Kirara receives<CR>the honorable "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award"!

records.jp: ……ありがとう、愛央
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Ao.
records.en: ...Thank you, Ao.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんかな！
records.en_original: I think Hiori wins this one!
records.en_auxiliary: I think Hiori wins this one!
records.en: Hiori-san, I think!

records.jp: 作業室で、陽桜莉さんがめちゃくちゃ頑張って<CR>鍋洗ってるの見たから
records.en_original: I saw you really scrubbing down the pots in the work room.
records.en_auxiliary: I saw you really scrubbing down the pots in the work room.
records.en: Because I saw Hiori-san working incredibly hard<CR>scrubbing the pots in the work room.

records.jp: 私、作業室には特別な想いがあって……<CR>私が綺麗にしてあげたかったんだよね
records.en_original: I have a special attachment to the work room. I just had to be the one to clean it.
records.en_auxiliary: I have a special attachment to the work room. I just had to be the one to clean it.
records.en: The work room holds special feelings for me...<CR>I wanted to be the one to clean it.

records.jp: 特別な想い？
records.en_original: A special attachment?
records.en_auxiliary: A special attachment?
records.en: Special feelings?

records.jp: みんなが私のために、カレーを作ってくれたでしょ。<CR>……あれが、すべての始まりだったから
records.en_original: Remember when everybody made curry for me? That's when it all started.
records.en_auxiliary: Remember when everybody made curry for me? That's when it all started.
records.en: Everyone made curry for me, remember?<CR>...That was where everything began.

records.jp: 家族の思い出のカレーが<CR>みんなとの思い出のカレーにもなった……
records.en_original: Curry didn't just remind me of my family anymore, I started to associate it with my friends too.
records.en_auxiliary: Curry didn't just remind me of my family anymore, I started to associate it with my friends too.
records.en: The curry that held memories of my family<CR>also became curry filled with memories of everyone...

records.jp: みんなや、お姉ちゃんがいたから<CR>私は今日まで頑張ってこられたんだよ
records.en_original: I've only made it this far because of Mio and all of you.
records.en_auxiliary: I've only made it this far because of Mio and all of you.
records.en: Because everyone and Onee-chan were here,<CR>I was able to keep going until today.

records.jp: だから、そんなお礼の気持ちを込めて<CR>お掃除してたの
records.en_original: So, I put those feelings of gratitude into washing and cleaning the work room.
records.en_auxiliary: So, I put those feelings of gratitude into washing and cleaning the work room.
records.en: So I cleaned it<CR>with all those feelings of gratitude.

records.jp: 私は、その気持ちが大事だと思う！
records.en_original: I think those feelings are very important!
records.en_auxiliary: I think those feelings are very important!
records.en: I think those feelings are what matters!

records.jp: 名誉ある「お掃除頑張ったで賞」を、<CR>平原　陽桜莉に授けます！
records.en_original: The honor of receiving the Best Cleaner Award is yours, Hiori Hirahara!
records.en_auxiliary: The honor of receiving the Best Cleaner Award is yours, Hiori Hirahara!
records.en: The honorable "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award"<CR>goes to Hirahara Hiori!

records.jp: えへへ……照れくさいけど、嬉しいな。<CR>ありがとう、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Ehehe... You're going to make me blush. Thanks, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: Ehehe... You're going to make me blush. Thanks, Ao!
records.en: Ehehe... You're going to make<CR>me blush. Thanks, Ao-chan!

records.jp: 美弦さん、撫で回すように……じゃなくて、<CR>愛おしむようにモップをかけてたよね！
records.en_original: Mio, you mopped the hallways with such loving strokes... I-I mean, you put so much care into it!
records.en_auxiliary: Mio, you mopped the hallways with such loving strokes... I-I mean, you put so much care into it!
records.en: Mio-san, you were moving the mop as if caressing it... no,<CR>as if cherishing it, right?

records.jp: ……ここを私たちみんなが、幾度となく行き交った<CR>と思うと、無下にはできなかった
records.en_original: When I thought about how we walked these halls every day, I just couldn't help it.
records.en_auxiliary: When I thought about how we walked these halls every day, I just couldn't help it.
records.en: When I thought of how many times all of us<CR>had passed through here, I could not treat it carelessly.

records.jp: 廊下、いっぱい歩いたり走ったりしたよね
records.en_original: We did walk and run through them so many times.
records.en_auxiliary: We did walk and run through them so many times.
records.en: We walked and ran through this hallway a lot, did we not?

records.jp: ええ。他の場所もそうだけれど、私にとっては一番、<CR>みんなやここでの日々を思わせる場所だわ
records.en_original: Yes. We did spend time in other rooms too, but these halls remind me of our time together the most.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. We did spend time in other rooms too, but these halls remind me of our time together the most.
records.en: Yes. The same is true of other places, but for me,<CR>this one reminds me most of everyone and our days here.

records.jp: それでは、栄誉ある「お掃除頑張ったで賞」を、<CR>平原　美弦に授けます！
records.en_original: The honor of receiving the Best Cleaner Award is yours, Mio Hirahara!
records.en_auxiliary: The honor of receiving the Best Cleaner Award is yours, Mio Hirahara!
records.en: Then the glorious "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award"<CR>goes to Hirahara Mio!

records.jp: ……ありがとう、愛央。<CR>大切にさせてもらうわ
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao. I will cherish this.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Ao. I will cherish this.
records.en: Thank you, Ao.<CR>I will cherish this.

records.jp: 詩さん、花壇の花に話しかけてたよね。<CR>「ありがとう」……って
records.en_original: Uta, I saw you talking to the flowers in the garden. I heard you saying thanks to them.
records.en_auxiliary: Uta, I saw you talking to the flowers in the garden. I heard you saying thanks to them.
records.en: Uta-san, you were talking to the flowers in the flower bed.<CR>You said, "Thank you"...

records.jp: 何故そんな言葉が出てきたのか、私にも不思議です。<CR>ただ……手入れをしていたら、感じたんです
records.en_original: I am not sure myself why such words escaped my lips. But in taking care of them, I just felt...
records.en_auxiliary: I am not sure myself why such words escaped my lips. But in taking care of them, I just felt...
records.en: Even I don't know why those words came out.<CR>But... as I was tending to them, I felt it.

records.jp: 花壇の花たちが、いつの間にか私の心に<CR>深く根付いていたことを……
records.en_original: I felt how deeply in my heart the flowers have taken root.
records.en_auxiliary: I felt how deeply in my heart the flowers have taken root.
records.en: That before I knew it, the flowers in the flower bed<CR>had taken root deep within my heart...

records.jp: 私を赦し、癒し続けてくれていたことを。<CR>そうしたら……言葉が出てきて……
records.en_original: I realized how they've been healing me all this time, and I wanted to let them know how I felt.
records.en_auxiliary: I realized how they've been healing me all this time, and I wanted to let them know how I felt.
records.en: That they had continued to forgive and heal me.<CR>Then... the words came out...

records.jp: 「ありがとう」って、思ったんだね。<CR>詩さん。花たちもきっと、喜んでるよ
records.en_original: So the words just flowed out of you, huh? I'm sure the flowers were happy to hear you say that, Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: So the words just flowed out of you, huh? I'm sure the flowers were happy to hear you say that, Uta.
records.en: You felt, "Thank you," did you not, Uta-san?<CR>I am sure the flowers are happy too.

records.jp: 詩さん……「お掃除頑張ったで賞」を<CR>駒川　詩に授けます。受け取ってくれる？
records.en_original: Uta, I bestow upon you the Best Cleaner Award. Will you accept it?
records.en_auxiliary: Uta, I bestow upon you the Best Cleaner Award. Will you accept it?
records.en: Uta-san... I present the "Worked Hard at Cleaning Award"<CR>to Komagawa Uta. Will you accept it?

records.jp: もちろんです。<CR>星崎さん、みなさん……ありがとうございます
records.en_original: Of course. Ao, everyone... Thank you so much.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. Ao, everyone... Thank you so much.
records.en: Of course.<CR>Hoshizaki-san, everyone... thank you very much.

records.jp: （この校舎とお別れするのは、少し寂しいけど……）
records.en_original: (It's kind of sad that we have to leave this school, but...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's kind of sad that we have to leave this school, but...)
records.en: (It's a little sad to say goodbye to this school, but...)

records.jp: （いつまでも、ここにはいられない）
records.en_original: (We can't stay here forever.)
records.en_auxiliary: (We can't stay here forever.)
records.en: (We can't stay here forever.)

records.jp: （私たちの夏休みも、もう終わりなんだ……）
records.en_original: (Our summer vacation is coming to an end.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Our summer vacation is coming to an end.)
records.en: (Our summer vacation is almost over...)
